risk_if_not_implemented: Without Attribute Displays for Output Devices, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Attribute Displays for Output Devices (DCH-37.5) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Media Marking
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to mark media in accordance with data protection requirements so that personnel are alerted to distribution limitations, handling caveats and applicable security requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Media Marking (DCH-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Attribute Displays for Output Devices (DCH-37.5) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
